maria: heads up — a customer running the onboarding sampleapp hit a cascade: 429s during token rotation, client retried and created duplicate sessions, they saw double charges. logs attached (redacted). @jon @sahil can you eyeball?
jon: can you paste the minimal repro + which SDK version they used? did the sample app set an Idempotency-Key header?
maria: repro: user signs up -> sampleapp exchanges token -> a 429 from inference endpoint -> client retries automatically. sampleapp is using python SDK v0.9.2 (the quickstart). it doesn't expose idempotency in the example. log excerpt: 
```
WARN create-session failed 429 {"retry_after":0.8}
INFO retrying request id=null
INFO create-session success id=sk_xxx
```
jon: ok that pattern screams unsafe replay on 429 + token refresh. without an idempotency key the backend treats retries as distinct.
sahil: two quick notes: 1) backoff should be exponential with full jitter (avoid synchronized retries), 2) sample apps should demonstrate setting an Idempotency-Key for any mutation. also FYI node+go SDKs already have helper that auto-generates idempotency keys for non-streaming mutates; python is behind here.
claire: do we want the sampleapp to opt-in or make idempotency a default for create-session flows? making it default in SDK could change semantics for some customers.
kevin: recommendation: default SDK behavior = exponential backoff with full jitter + NOT auto-idempotify unless endpoint annotated as safe-for-auto-idempotency. config knobs: `safe_replay_window` (default 10s), `retry.base_ms=100`, `retry.cap_ms=2000`, `retry.attempts=6`. example pseudo: 
```
# backoff (full jitter)
backoff = min(cap_ms, base_ms * 2**attempt)
sleep = random.uniform(0, backoff)
```
and python snippet to add idempotency header in sampleapp: 
```python
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Idempotency-Key": str(uuid.uuid4())}
resp = requests.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
```
maria: thanks — i can open a tiny PR to the sampleapp showing header injection + recommend SDK upgrade in the quickstart. i'll also file a ticket to add parity for python SDK helpers. should we also add a short note in onboarding that token refresh can cause spurious retries?
sahil: yes add a short explainer in onboarding docs and link to the retry/backoff playbook. also add a test-case in sampleapp e2e simulating 429 during refresh.
claire: assign the python parity ticket to @sahil? or @kevin? whoever owns python SDK.
kevin: i'll take the parity ticket and coordinate a small API to opt into auto-idempotency with explicit annotation on mutation calls.
maria: great — i'll open the sampleapp PR now and include changelog + small why-note. tagging this thread for follow-up: will post PR link and ticket id here. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: CI passed for maria/sampleapp#42, staging deploy queued.
maria: awesome, thanks all — i'll follow up with PR/ticket links and a tiny onboarding blurb.
